rules.statement: The determination of relevance under section 2 is based on the nature of the evidence in question.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) What is relevant under section 2(4) C is not whether the plaintiff himself occupied the relevant premises on. 01.01.1980, as its owner but whether the premises were occupied on that day by its owner (whether it be the plaintiff or not is immaterial) or by a tenant

rules.statement: The occupation of premises on 01.01.1980 was determined by whether the owner or a tenant occupied the relevant premises, not by who the owner was.
